articles.summary: News Corp to Participate in the Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference New York, NY (September 1, 2026) – News Corp announced today that Chief Financial Officer Lavanya Chandrashekar will participate in the Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference on Tuesday, September 8, 2026.
